title: History Entry
description: Single change record placed in services/<service>/history/. The directory acts as an append-only log of meaningful policy or catalog changes that downstream tools can surface to users.

date.description: Date the change took effect or was first observed (ISO 8601).

summary.description: One or two sentence human-readable summary of what changed.

diff_url.description: Link to a diff, blog post, or archive comparison that documents the change.

severity.description: How impactful the change is for end users.
